header: No Pro models. My decision (23 Nov 2026): "we will no way use Pro any more" (an Executive Deep Search answer on gemini-3.1-pro-preview cost about Rs 35, on Flash about Rs 7). A model whose name says it is a Pro model (gemini-3.1-pro-preview, gemini-pro-latest, gemini-2.5-pro ...) is refused at the three places that can send a request to one, whatever asks for it (a code default, an environment variable on this machine or on Vercel, a script): geminiGenerate (src/lib/ai/geminiChat.ts: every text and JSON call), the page readers (src/lib/ingestion/pageReader.ts, geminiOcr.ts) and the model-name helpers that feed them. I made the refusal a switch: PERF.allowProModels in src/lib/perf/switches.js (false = refused; true = the previous behaviour). Pure: no network, no database.

symbols.name: isProModel
doc: Matches a name that says "Pro": gemini-3.1-pro-preview, gemini-pro-latest, models/gemini-2.5-pro, and the same for any other maker's "-pro" tier.

symbols.name: modelAllowed
doc: True when this model may be asked: it is not a Pro model, or the switch allows Pro models.

symbols.name: tell
symbols.sig: function tell(name: string, where: string): void
doc: I say once, in the server log, that a Pro model was asked for and refused.

symbols.name: withoutPro
symbols.sig: export function withoutPro(models: string[], where = "model chain"): string[]
doc: Returns the models of a chain without the Pro ones; the order of the rest is kept.

symbols.name: orReplacement
symbols.sig: export function orReplacement(name: string, replacement: string, where = "model"): string
doc: Returns one model name: itself when allowed, otherwise the replacement.

behaviours: other names are not Pro (flash, flash-lite, embedding, claude, a word that only contains 'pro')
withoutPro drops Pro and keeps the order of the rest
orReplacement gives the replacement for Pro and the name itself otherwise
GEMINI_SYNTHESIS_MODEL=gemini-3.1-pro-preview does not bring Pro back: the writer's chain has no Pro
GEMINI_VERIFY_MODEL=gemini-pro-latest does not bring Pro back: the checker's chain has no Pro
the chat chain is Pro-free by the guard of geminiGenerate (checked below), and its default has no Pro
the default chains have no Pro
geminiGenerate with only Pro models sends no request and fails clearly
a mixed chain asks only the Flash model
the OCR defaults are Flash (a main reader and a different checker)
OCR readers asked to be Pro are Flash instead
the page reader asked to be Pro by the environment is Flash
a page reader asked for Pro in its options is Flash
no source file names a Pro model in code (only comments may)
